_meta.indication: EYLEA is indicated for the treatment of patients with Neovascular (Wet) Age-Related Macular Degeneration (AMD)

pivotal_trials.nct: Not stated in the reviewed documents
pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-masked, active-controlled study comparing VEGF Trap-Eye to 0.5 mg ranibizumab, with a 10% non-inferiority margin
pivotal_trials.population: Subjects with neovascular (wet) age-related macular degeneration
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Proportion of subjects who maintained vision at Week 52 (lost fewer than 15 ETDRS letters vs baseline), assessed for non-inferiority to ranibizumab
pivotal_trials.n: Approximately 1210 subjects randomized in VIEW 1 across the four treatment arms (R0.5Q4 N=304, 2Q4 N=304, 0.5Q4 N=301, 2Q8 N=301)
pivotal_trials.result: Aflibercept 2 mg q8 week met non-inferiority: 284 (94.4%) maintained vision vs 285 (93.8%) ranibizumab; difference -0.6 (95.1% CI -4.4, 3.2)

pivotal_trials.nct: Not stated in the reviewed documents
pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-masked, active-controlled study comparing VEGF Trap-Eye to 0.5 mg ranibizumab, with a 10% non-inferiority margin
pivotal_trials.population: Subjects with neovascular (wet) age-related macular degeneration
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Proportion of subjects who maintained vision at Week 52 (lost fewer than 15 ETDRS letters vs baseline), assessed for non-inferiority to ranibizumab
pivotal_trials.n: Approximately 1200 subjects randomized in VIEW 2 across the four treatment arms (R0.5Q4 N=291, 2Q4 N=309, 0.5Q4 N=296, 2Q8 N=306)
pivotal_trials.result: Aflibercept 2 mg q8 week met non-inferiority: 292 (95.4%) maintained vision vs 276 (94.9%) ranibizumab; difference -0.6 (95.1% CI -4.1, 2.9)

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (≥5%): conjunctival hemorrhage (25% EYLEA vs 28% ranibizumab), eye pain (9% vs 9%), cataract (7% vs 7%), vitreous detachment (6% vs 6%), vitreous floaters, and increased intraocular pressure. Serious risks include endophthalmitis, retinal detachment, increased intraocular pressure, and thromboembolic events
target_moa: Aflibercept is a recombinant fusion protein that acts as a soluble decoy receptor binding VEGF-A and PlGF, inhibiting activation of VEGFR-1 and VEGFR-2

advisory_committee.vote: The Dermatologic and Ophthalmic Drugs Advisory Committee met June 17, 2011 and unanimously (all 10 voting members) agreed that adequate safety and efficacy had been demonstrated for treatment of neovascular AMD

summary.text: BLA 125387 was submitted February 17, 2011 and received a Priority Review because wet AMD is a serious sight-threatening disease and Eylea offered a significant improvement over available therapy. Approval was based on two Phase 3 non-inferiority trials (VIEW 1 and VIEW 2) versus ranibizumab, and the advisory committee voted unanimously in favor

citations.quote: The BLA was submitted February 17, 2011 and an acknowledgement letter sent March 8, 2011. The filing letter was sent April 15, 2011 (stated PDUFA goal is August 20, 2011) and the application was filed under 21 CFR 601.2(a). The expectation was noted that proposed labeling would be communicated July 23, 2011.

The applicant requested priority review, because wet AMD is a serious, sight-threatening disease and Eylea was considered to offer a significant improvement to available therapies. One of the regimens evaluated in Phase 3 trials was a 2 mg dose given every 8 weeks (following three loading doses of 2 mg given every 4 weeks). The currently approved Lucentis regimen is labeled for injection every 4 w

requirement.text: Conduct three drug product hold time studies of the 40 mg/mL vial presentation with microbiological sampling at end of hold times

citations.quote: To conduct three drug product hold time studies of the 40 mg/mL vial presentation filled at [REDACTED] site. Material will be held at commercial scale, and microbiological samples (total viable count, bacterial endotoxin) will be taken at the end of the hold times. The completed validation report will be submitted as a CBE-0 supplement.

requirement.text: Conduct three drug product hold time studies for the 40 mg/mL vial presentation including product-quality evaluation (pH, purity, charge variants, potency)

citations.quote: To conduct three drug product hold time studies for the 40 mg/mL vial presentation filled at the [REDACTED] site. These studies will include t=0 and end of hold samples for product quality (pH, purity by size exclusion, purity by nrSDS-PAGE, charge variant distribution by IEF, isoaspartate, and potency of aflibercept) evaluation. The completed validation report will be provided as a CBE-0 supplement.

requirement.text: Re-evaluate release and shelf-life specifications for aflibercept drug product after 30 commercial manufacturing runs

citations.quote: To re-evaluate the release and shelf-life specifications for aflibercept drug product after 30 commercial manufacturing runs to reflect increased manufacturing experience. The revisions to the quality control system, the corresponding data from the 30 commercial manufacturing runs, and the analysis and statistical plan used to evaluate the specifications and any changes to specifications will be provided in a PAS within 60 days after completion of the 30th lot manufactured using the commercial process or by December, 2014, whichever occurs first.
